carousel.002: An image or projected-content carousel with arrow, indicator, keyboard and horizontal touch gesture navigation. The gallery lets you compare sliding and fading and configure automatic playback.
carousel.004: Three images with demo titles and descriptions. Initial autoplay advances every 4 seconds. Pause stops the timer; Play also re-enables the Autoplay switch and starts a new interval. Dots selects a slide; Numbers only shows the count. With Loop disabled, arrows stop at the ends. Focus the carousel to use ← and →; a horizontal swipe beyond 40 px changes slides and pauses autoplay, which Play can restart.
